feature_definition: RATIO_RTE_ENTR = RTE / ENTR. RTE = Shannon entropy (nats) of white vertical line length (recurrence-time gap) distribution: per column j, gap lengths w of consecutive zeros between recurrent points excluding i==j; qualifying w>=w_min (w_min=1), p_w=n_w/sum_u n_u, RTE=-sum_w p_w*ln(p_w); fail-closed if <2 distinct qualifying gap lengths or entropy non-finite/non-positive. ENTR = Shannon entropy (nats) of diagonal line length distribution (standard RQA ENTR): qualifying diagonal lengths l>=l_min over upper-triangle diagonals k>=1, P(l)=n_l/sum_u n_u, ENTR=-sum_l P(l)*ln(P(l)); fail-closed if <2 distinct qualifying diagonal lengths or entropy non-finite/non-positive. On trailing W_RR=168 delay embedding (m=2,tau=1), L-inf recurrence eps=0.5*std(window). Causal trailing only; fail-closed to NaN/no-signal if RTE undefined/non-finite/degenerate, ENTR undefined/non-finite/degenerate, ratio non-finite, or insufficient qualifying lines/gaps.
